title: WeQuant service models
description: Each operation's request and result, and ErrorBody, the body of a failed one. From: uv run wequant schema --json > frontend/contract/service-models.schema.json

AnomaliesPage.description: Uses in archive order (date, code, channel, anomaly_date, kind, seq).
AnomaliesPage.title: AnomaliesPage

AnomaliesRequest.description: A run's uses of anomalous data, filtered.
AnomaliesRequest.title: AnomaliesRequest

AnomalyUse.description: One use of an anomalous cell by a run, a screen or an explain.

date.description: The decision day (signal), the fill day (fill) or the valued close (valuation).

anomaly_class.description: The archive's class column: price, volume, bar, gap, limits, status or adjustment.

root.description: Signal: the first root that read the cell; null otherwise.

full_history.description: Signal: that root reads a stock's whole history; null otherwise.

decision.description: Signal: the action (backtest) or role (screen, explain); null otherwise.

order_status.description: Fill: filled, partial or the rejection reason; null otherwise.

value.description: Valuation: yuan of the holding; null otherwise.

seq.description: Fill: the order's row in the orders frame; 0 otherwise.

AnomalyUse.title: AnomalyUse

ArchiveRequest.description: Archive a strategy (hidden from the list, files kept), or restore it.
ArchiveRequest.title: ArchiveRequest

BacktestRequest.description: A strategy (inline or saved) over a date range.

data_version.description: Store version to read (default: the current one).

start.description: Base day: the first trading day on or after it; null: the panel's first day.

end.description: Last day: the last trading day on or before it; null: the panel's last day.

cash.description: Yuan, a whole number of fen.

benchmark.description: An index_bars code; null: no benchmark.

BacktestRequest.title: BacktestRequest

BacktestResult.description: A finished run's identity, metrics, orders, delisted holdings, anomalies and warnings.

saved.description: Archived (also when an identical run was already).

delisted.description: Delisted holdings the run handled, by date.

BacktestResult.title: BacktestResult

Bars.description: Each cell's values: prices and amount in yuan, volume in shares, adj_* back-adjusted, masks 1.0/0.0.
Bars.title: Bars

BarsRequest.description: Panel fields of a few codes over a date range.

data_version.description: Store version to read (default: the current one).

codes.description: Codes such as 600000.SH, in output order.

start.description: First day (default: the first trading day).

end.description: Last day (default: the last trading day).

BarsRequest.title: BarsRequest

CheckReport.description: The check's counts and report; ok when a current check is recorded and, in a dry run, every breach is too.

ok.description: True when the check found nothing to act on.

committed.description: New version, or null if none was made.

current.description: The final version (committed, else checked) records a current limit check.

breaches.description: Bars that trade outside their limits.

missing.description: Breaches found but not recorded at data_version.

stale.description: Breaches recorded at data_version but no longer found.

report_path.description: The report's path relative to the data root, written on commit.

report.description: The markdown report, as written on commit.

CheckReport.title: CheckReport

CheckRequest.description: The price-limit check of the current store version.

commit.description: Record breaches and the limit_check block in a new version under the writer lock, and write the report.

CheckRequest.title: CheckRequest

ConditionSpec.description: A condition every stock must pass at the decision day's close.

expr.description: A condition (bool) expression; cross-sectional operators rank within the pool.

ConditionSpec.title: ConditionSpec

CountSpan.description: A run of days whose member count is off the nominal count.

count.description: Members on each day of the span.

CountSpan.title: CountSpan

DailyRow.description: One day of a run, the base day first; the derived columns use wequant.analytics' definitions.

benchmark.description: Index close; null: no benchmark or no close that day.

invested.description: Yuan of holdings at the close.

nav.description: equity / initial cash, 1 on the base day.

benchmark_nav.description: benchmark / its base-day close; null: no benchmark or no close.

DailyRow.title: DailyRow

DataAnomaly.description: How much anomalous data a result used; with exclude_day only the unavoidable remainder.

decisions.description: Decisions whose signal windows read an anomalous cell.

max_share.description: Largest share of equity held on anomalous cells.

unavoidable.description: Uses exclusion cannot remove point-in-time (adjustment and gap classes).

sample.description: The first 20 uses by date (all of them for a screen).

DataAnomaly.title: DataAnomaly

DataSpec.description:
How a run treats anomalous data; outside the strategy, part of the run's inputs.

Excluding is a robustness check, not a point-in-time rule: anomaly labels may rest on the next day's data.

anomalies.description: flag: use and report; exclude_day: read error-level anomalous stock-days as missing.

DataSpec.title: DataSpec

DataStatus.description: One store version: its tables and meta, next to the versions the store keeps.

limit_check_current.description: The version records a limit check of its own inputs with the current rule book.

meta.description: Every other manifest key, such as source and limit_check.

DataStatus.title: DataStatus

DecisionRow.description: A target, backup or held stock on a decision day.
DecisionRow.title: DecisionRow

DelistedRow.description: A delisted holding a run handled.

date.description: The trading day at whose open it was handled.

cash.description: Yuan returned as cash (0 for a write-down without recovery).

DelistedRow.title: DelistedRow

delist_date.description: The official delisting date; null until S2.3 provides it.

day.description: The trading day at whose open a holding is handled; null: not yet in the calendar.

approximate.description: day comes from the data's last date, not the official one.

classified_by.description: rule, or an override entry of the data root's overrides/delisting.toml.

evidence.description: The override's evidence; null for the rule.

source.description: Where the override's evidence comes from; null for the rule.

recovery.description: Share of the last close returned as cash; null when held.

Delistings.description: Every delisted code of the store version, with its basis and treatment.

overrides.description: An overrides file exists in the data root.

Delistings.title: Delistings

DelistingsRequest.description: The delisted codes of a store version, treated under an execution block.

data_version.description: Store version to read (default: the current one).

DelistingsRequest.title: DelistingsRequest

ErrorBody.description: A failed operation: its exit code, why, and the located details; the error body of the HTTP API.

name.description: The Exit member's name, e.g. USAGE.

ErrorBody.title: ErrorBody

ErrorDetail.description: One located reason an operation failed.

code.description: A stable code, only ever added to: e.g. unknown_field, out_of_range, version_not_kept.

message.description: English; names the item when names repeat.

loc.description: Where in the request, pydantic style: e.g. ["strategy", "filters", 2, "expr"]; empty for the whole request.

path.description: Where inside an expression form ([name, arg0, arg1, ...]: argument i at index i + 1); empty for all of it.

ErrorDetail.title: ErrorDetail

EvalRequest.description: A form evaluated for a few codes over a date range.

form.description: Canonical form as JSON text, e.g. '["MA","adj_close",20]' or '"close"'.

data_version.description: Store version to read (default: the current one).

codes.description: Codes such as 600000.SH, in output order.

start.description: First day (default: the first trading day).

end.description: Last day (default: the last trading day).

EvalRequest.title: EvalRequest

EvalResult.description: The form's value in each cell, as values.value.
EvalResult.title: EvalResult

ExecutionSpec.description: How orders fill and what a run pays; outside the strategy, part of the run's inputs.

price.description: The fill day's raw open (or close).

min_commission.description: Yuan per order, a whole number of fen.

slippage_bps.description: Per side, a cost on the trade value; never moves the fill price or the limit checks.

delisting.description: auto: write down forced delistings, cash mergers at the last close, hold long suspensions; hold: as before.

failure_recovery.description: Share of its last close a written-down holding returns as cash, for sensitivity checks.

ExecutionSpec.title: ExecutionSpec

Exit.description: Exit codes of the wequant command; README.md lists the same table.
Exit.title: Exit

Explain.description: Why a stock was or was not chosen on a day, and with a run what happened to it.

missing.description: Not scored for want of this factor (or formula); null otherwise.

execution.description: t+1's orders of this stock, forced exits included; null without a run.

Explain.title: Explain

ExplainRequest.description: A stock and a day, for a strategy (inline or saved) or an archived run: exactly one of the three.

date.description: The decision day; with a run also a fill day.

data.description: null: flag without a run, the run's options with one (then it must be null).

data_version.description: null: the current version, or the run's (then it must be null).

ExplainRequest.title: ExplainRequest

ExprCheck.description: A valid expression's canonical key and kind.

key.description: Canonical compact JSON: what results are cached and archived by.

kind.description: num for a number, bool for a condition (1.0/0.0).

ExprCheck.title: ExprCheck

ExprRequest.description: A signal expression in canonical form.

form.description: Canonical form as JSON text, e.g. '["MA","adj_close",20]' or '"close"'.

ExprRequest.title: ExprRequest

FactorCell.description: One enabled factor of a scored stock.

pct.description: Percentile of value among the scored stocks, in (0, 1].

adjusted_pct.description: The percentile of value, of -value for a factor preferring low values: what the score uses.

contribution.description: weight_share x adjusted_pct; the contributions add up to score.

FactorCell.title: FactorCell

pct.description: Percentile of value among the scored stocks, in (0, 1].

adjusted_pct.description: The percentile of value, of -value for a factor preferring low values: what the score uses.

contribution.description: weight_share x adjusted_pct; the contributions add up to score.

FactorSpec.description: A scoring factor: ranked as a percentile among the scored stocks, weighted.

weight.description: Relative weight; weights are normalised over the enabled factors.

FactorSpec.title: FactorSpec

FeeRule.description: A stamp-tax or transfer-fee rule in force during the run, for display.

until.description: The day before the next rule of its table; null: in force to the run's end.

basis.description: Transfer fee on the trade value or on par value; null: stamp tax.

note.description: The rule's confirm note; null: primary source known.

FeeRule.title: FeeRule

FunnelStep.description: One level of the funnel, in order: listed, bar, universe, pool items, filters, scored, targets, backups.

step.description: The level's name, or the condition or group name.

chain.description: False for conditions inside a group, targets and backups.

passed.description: Passing alone: pool items within the universe, filters within the pool; else equal to left.

left.description: Left along the chain; on chain levels, rejects at level k = left[k-1] - left[k]; null off the chain.

FunnelStep.title: FunnelStep

GroupSpec.description: Conditions combined: all of them, or any of them.
GroupSpec.title: GroupSpec

IndexCheck.description: Each index's coverage; ok is False when any index has an anomalous span.

ok.description: True when the check found nothing to act on.

IndexCheck.title: IndexCheck

IndexCheckRequest.description: The index members of one store version.

data_version.description: Store version to read (default: the current one).

IndexCheckRequest.title: IndexCheckRequest

IndexCoverage.description: One index's coverage and its anomalous spans.

stored_as.description: The code its rows carry in index_members, e.g. 399300.SZ.

nominal.description: The nominal member count; null: none (CSI All Share).

IndexCoverage.title: IndexCoverage

IssueCount.description: Matching rows of one (table, kind, action).
IssueCount.title: IssueCount

IssueRow.description: One data_issues row; detail is its JSON text as stored.
IssueRow.title: IssueRow

Issues.description: The matching rows: their total, their counts and the first limit of them by (table, code, date, kind).
Issues.title: Issues

IssuesRequest.description: data_issues rows to list, by exact match on each given filter.

data_version.description: Store version to read (default: the current one).

codes.description: Affected codes; data_issues keeps a malformed code as found.

limit.description: Rows to return at most; total and counts cover every match.

IssuesRequest.title: IssuesRequest

passed.description: null: no value, which fails too.

MetricDiff.description: A metric that differs between two runs.
MetricDiff.title: MetricDiff

unit.description: fraction, ratio, days, count or date.

reason.description: Why there is no value; null when there is one.

MetricSpecModel.description: The metric conventions of a run.
MetricSpecModel.title: MetricSpecModel

OperationModels.description: One operation and the names of its request and result models.

operation.description: The function in wequant.service, e.g. data_bars for wequant data bars.

available.description: False: its models are fixed and its command is still to come.

OperationModels.title: OperationModels

OrderCounts.description: Orders of a run by status; forced delisting exits counted apart.

forced.description: delist_write_down and delist_exit rows, not in the counts above.

OrderCounts.title: OrderCounts

OrderRow.description: One order of a run, as archived.

requested.description: Shares asked for (the whole holding for a full exit).

price.description: Yuan, raw fill price (0 for a write-down); null: no bar that day.

day_amount.description: Yuan the stock traded that day; null: unknown.

reason.description: Why rejected or partial, or delist_write_down / delist_exit; null: filled rebalance order.

OrderRow.title: OrderRow

OrdersPage.description: Orders in archive order: date, batch, submission.
OrdersPage.title: OrdersPage

PeriodRow.description: One year or month of a run, not annualised.

benchmark_return.description: null: no benchmark, or a missing close in the period.

max_drawdown.description: Within the period, from the previous period's last nav.

Periods.description: Returns by year and by month.
Periods.title: Periods

passed.description: null: no value, which fails too.

value.description: bar: t's close; index: membership; boards: the stock's board; exclude_st: its ST flag; min_list_days: list days.

note.description: e.g. listing days counted from the data's first day before S2.3.

index.description: Members of this index on the decision day; null: any.

boards.description: Only these boards, no repeats; null: any board (the frontend writes null for all three).

exclude_st.description: Leave out stocks that are ST on the decision day (ST is unknown on the seed store).

min_list_days.description: Leave out stocks listed for fewer trading days; null: no limit.

PositionRow.description: A holding at a day's close.
PositionRow.title: PositionRow

ProfileReport.description: An operation's total time and its stages in first-seen order.

passed.description: False: failed; null: no value, which fails too.

value.description: A simple comparison's expression side; null otherwise or without a value.

op.description: The comparison, the constant moved to the right; null: not a simple comparison.

missing.description: At scored: the first factor without a value, or formula.

Row.description: One (date, code) cell; a value is null where the panel holds NaN or infinity.

status.description: The descriptive day status: a later bar can change it.

decisions.description: Empty when not a decision day.

orders.description: Filled, rejected and forced, in archive order.

text.description: The expression's canonical form as written.

form.description: The canonical form, defaults left out.

saved_as.description: Saved versions with this content; empty: an unsaved variant.

weight_shares.description: Each enabled factor's share of the total weight, in factor order; empty: no enabled factor.

StrategyRequest.description: A strategy to check or summarise.

StrategySpec.description:
What a rebalance strategy holds and when; defaults are left out of its canonical form.

Cross-field rules (hold_rank > top_n, formula only with formula weighting, unique names) are checked by the core
and reported with codes by strategy validate.

universe.description: A condition expression: the scope, before the pool items.

top_n.description: Number of targets; null: every scored stock.

formula.description: The weight formula, with formula weighting only.

band.description: Resize a kept target only when its weight is off by more than this share of its target; null: never.

anchor.description: The trading day expressions count from; null: the calendar's first day.

hold_rank.description: Keep a holding while it ranks within this many (> top_n); null: no buffer.

max_weight.description: Cap on one target's weight; the excess goes to the other targets, cash only when none can take it.

StrategySpec.title: StrategySpec

StrategySummary.description: The Chinese summary sentence and its fragments.

SummaryPart.description: One fragment of the summary sentence, pointing at the strategy fields it describes.

params.description: Its numbers, e.g. {"top_n": 20} or each factor's weight share; empty: none.

SummaryPart.title: SummaryPart

strategy_version.description: STRATEGY_VERSION when saved; null: unknown (a version rebuilt from its file).

text.description: English, for logs: a fixed template filled from params.

params.description: Every number and date of text (dates ISO, shares as 0..1); the frontend renders its own text from these.
